text:
Ivy: Quick report from device lab: on a Galaxy Fold when unfolded the right inspection panel overlays the routes table actions so users can't tap quick-edit. short vid: https://imgur.com/foldable-ux2.mp4
Marco: can repro. seems like stacking context + transform. The panel uses transform for animation which creates a new stacking context and lifts it over the table.
Sonal: UX options: 1) reserve a 48px tap-safe gutter on the table when split view is active, 2) collapse right panel to icon-only at narrow split widths. Prefer 1 for discoverability.
Ethan: dev note: simplest fix is to avoid transform on the panel and animate opacity + translateY instead. Also add .table { padding-right: 48px } when .panel--split active so controls stay tappable.
accessibility-bot: accessibility: when panel toggles, ensure focus is not trapped in split mode and add aria-expanded on the panel trigger. Also announce the quick-edit toolbar with aria-live="polite" when it appears.
Ivy: copy nit: change inline menu label from "Edit" to "Quick edit" on mobile. Also ensure tooltips are not the only affordance.
Marco: noted. I'll send a small PR with: remove transform from panel, add padding-right clamp for split widths, and a tiny translate animation for the quick-edit so it remains above panel z-order. Will include visual tests and a device lab clip.
Sonal: extra ask: preserve keyboard focus across fold/unfold transitions. store focused element id and reapply focus after resize. Add a 200ms debounce on orientation change.
Ethan: will include focus-preserve helper and tests. tagging RD-3633 as P3.
Ivy: thanks — accept when PR includes aria changes, visual tests, and the short device clip.
